sloka: एवम् मन्ये गुणवताम् गुणानाम् फलम् उच्यते ।पित्रा मात्रा च यत् साधुर् वीरः निर्वास्यते वनम् ॥२-३९-११॥
transliteration: evam manye guṇavatām guṇānām phalam ucyate ।pitrā mātrā ca yat sādhur vīraḥ nirvāsyate vanam ॥2-39-11॥

translations.english: That the pious and heroic son is banished by his parents to the forest is, I think, the reward to the virtuous for his virtues.
